## Course description

MATE 374 develops numerical modeling skills through materials-engineering questions. Students formulate models, select computational methods, verify numerical results, and interpret predictions with appropriate units and limitations.

## Provisional learning emphasis

- model geometry, physical reasoning, verification, and interpretation;
- numerical concepts and method selection;
- only the coding mechanics needed to make work reproducible.

::: {.callout-warning}
Assessment weights, prerequisites, and software policy still need confirmation.
:::

## Course schedule

The working [Fall 2026 schedule](schedule.qmd) maps 35 instructional lectures and one tentative in-class midterm onto the official term calendar. A companion [seminar plan](seminars.qmd) proposes 12 TA-led, marimo-supported computational studios beginning in the second week.

## Provisional assessment architecture

The current recommendation is [five individual computational investigations](../assignments/index.qmd) plus [one staged team project](../project/index.qmd). Exact weights and due dates remain subject to official constraints.
